A row nested directly inside a cell keeps its visible text

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<table><tr><td><tr><td>Visible text</td></tr></td></tr></table>"
    result = convert(html)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
